dedupe_keys.name: smart meter anomaly detection dataset pseudo labelled via ensembled ml models

description: Ashish Rauniyar at SINTEF Digital publishes electricity-consumption readings with machine-generated anomaly labels. The free Zenodo CSV uses CC BY 4.0. Its description reports hourly readings from seventy-four smart meters over one year, labelled by an XGBoost and LightGBM ensemble trained on the LEAD building dataset. These traces can test anomaly-observation components in demand and smart-meter simulations. Related G6 data-iskraemeco-controlled-laboratory-smart-meter-data is the deposit explicitly linked as an input, but that source describes six laboratory meters, not seventy-four field meters. This unresolved provenance mismatch is retained. Pseudo-labels represent model decisions, not independently confirmed faults, and the exact observation year and location are unspecified. Class balance, transfer accuracy and missingness require further checking. No CSV rows were downloaded or prediction accuracy assessed. The site tag describes the collection scale; its location is unknown.
